ns2:section.sectionText: Learn statistical methods for applied economics. Focus will be on answering questions with the multiple regression model. We cover common econometric problems. The course also covers an introduction to the statistical language R. All exercises will be conducted in R and RStudio, but no prior experience in R is expected or required. Prerequisite: MATH 124 or MATH 125; ACE 261 or ACE 262 or ECON 202 or equivalent. This course is reserved for ACE students until the Friday before classes begin. At approximately 10:00 a.m. on that date, this section will open to all of campus to allow non-ACE students to register.
